summary: Creates an IANA registry for IMAP keywords, the flags clients can set on messages, and defines how to register new ones. The goal is to help different IMAP clients interoperate by agreeing on what each keyword means. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: It is a shared list of sticker names for emails, so every mail app means the same thing by a sticker called important.

questions: how to register an imap keyword
